using System;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Drawing;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Entities;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Drawing;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Jellyfin.Drawing.Tests;

public class ImageProcessorTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void GetImageDimensions_WhenWidthAndHeightAreZero_LogsDebugMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<ImageProcessor>>();
        var mockItem = new Mock<BaseItem>();
        mockItem.Setup(i => i.GetType().Name).Returns("TestItem");

        var imageInfo = new ItemImageInfo
        {
            Width = 0,
            Height = 0,
            Path = "/test/path.jpg"
        };

        // Create ImageProcessor instance (other dependencies mocked minimally)
        var fileSystem = new Mock<IFileSystem>();
        var appPaths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
        appPaths.Setup(a => a.ImageCachePath).Returns("/cache");
        var imageEncoder = new Mock<IImageEncoder>();
        var config = new Mock<IServerConfigurationManager>();
        config.Setup(c => c.Configuration).Returns(new Mock<ServerConfiguration>().Object);

        var processor = new ImageProcessor(logger.Object, appPaths.Object, fileSystem.Object, imageEncoder.Object, config.Object);

        // Act
        processor.GetImageDimensions(mockItem.Object, imageInfo);

        // Assert
        logger.Verify(
            l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Debug,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Getting image size for item TestItem /test/path.jpg")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GetImageDimensions_WhenWidthAndHeightArePositive_DoesNotLogDebugMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<ImageProcessor>>();
        var mockItem = new Mock<BaseItem>();

        var imageInfo = new ItemImageInfo
        {
            Width = 1920,
            Height = 1080,
            Path = "/test/path.jpg"
        };

        // Create ImageProcessor instance (other dependencies mocked minimally)
        var fileSystem = new Mock<IFileSystem>();
        var appPaths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
        appPaths.Setup(a => a.ImageCachePath).Returns("/cache");
        var imageEncoder = new Mock<IImageEncoder>();
        var config = new Mock<IServerConfigurationManager>();
        config.Setup(c => c.Configuration).Returns(new Mock<ServerConfiguration>().Object);

        var processor = new ImageProcessor(logger.Object, appPaths.Object, fileSystem.Object, imageEncoder.Object, config.Object);

        // Act
        processor.GetImageDimensions(mockItem.Object, imageInfo);

        // Assert - no debug log expected since dimensions were already set
        logger.Verify(
            l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Debug,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.IsAny<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Never);
    }
}

            }
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GetImageDimensions_WhenWidthAndHeightAreZero_LogsDebugMessage()
    {
        // Arrange

        {
            Width = 0,
            Height = 0,
            Path = "/test/path.jpg"

        appPaths.Setup(a => a.ImageCachePath).Returns("/cache").Verifiable();
        var imageEncoder = new Mock<IImageEncoder>();
        imageEncoder.Setup(e => e.GetImageSize(It.IsAny<string>()))

        Assert.True(logger.DebugLogged);
        Assert.Contains("Getting image size for item TestItem /test/path.jpg", logger.LastMessage ?? "");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GetImageDimensions_WhenWidthAndHeightArePositive_DoesNotLogDebugMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new FakeLogger();
        var mockItem = new Mock<BaseItem>();

        var imageInfo = new ItemImageInfo
        {
            Width = 1920,
            Height = 1080,
            Path = "/test/path.jpg"
        };

        var fileSystem = new Mock<IFileSystem>().Object;
        var appPaths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
        appPaths.Setup(a => a.ImageCachePath).Returns("/cache");
        var imageEncoder = new Mock<IImageEncoder>();
        var config = new Mock<IServerConfigurationManager>();
        config.Setup(c => c.Configuration).Returns(new ServerConfiguration());

        var processor = new ImageProcessor(logger, appPaths.Object, fileSystem, imageEncoder.Object, config.Object);

        // Act
        processor.GetImageDimensions(mockItem.Object, imageInfo);

        // Assert - no debug log expected since dimensions were already set
        Assert.False(logger.DebugLogged);
    }
